messages:
Harper: Quick weekend poll — micro-adventure or couch hermit mode? Kayak at Lake Glen (Sat 8am) or movie marathon + pho at my place (Sat 6pm)? :kayak: :popcorn: :ramen:
Miguel: Kayak for me if the water's calm. otherwise Im down for pho.
Sana: Oof 8am is brutal. movie + pho sounds perfect. what movies are we thinking?
Olivia: Im team kayak but only if we can do a short loop and be back by noon. have to babysit later.
Harper: Loop is ~2 hours usually. we can do a quick paddle and then brunch for those who stay.
Miguel: If kayak wins, can someone bring sunscreen? I always forget and regret it. :sweat_smile:
Sana: If movie night, I can bring a spicy pho base + rice noodles. also have a weirdly good collection of 90s romcoms.
Olivia: @Harper can you confirm kayak parking situation? last time it filled up fast.
Harper: Good call — there's a free lot at the boat launch but only ~12 spots. I'll post a map and we can carpool.
reminders-bot: poll: "Saturday plans" options: [KayakMorning, Movie+PhoNight] current votes: KayakMorning (2), Movie+PhoNight (2)
Miguel: Tie! flipping a coin feels anticlimactic. Harper, any other tiebreaker ideas?
Harper: Okay since it's tied, new rule: if you bring gear you get to pick. Miguel you have the kayak straps so you win if you commit.
Miguel: Ill bring straps + sunscreen. Kayak it is for me.
Sana: Fine, Ill be the designated pho chef next time. Kayak crew, what time should we meet at the launch? 7:40 to unload?
Harper: Lets meet 7:30 to carpool and aim to launch by 8. Ill create the event and share the map. Thanks everyone! :boat: :sparkles:
